events.headline: UN PAUSES STRAIT OF HORMUZ EVACUATION PLAN AFTER CARGO SHIP ATTACKED
events.detail: The ship was reportedly struck by an "unknown projectile" near Oman but no casualties were reported.

events.detail: El barco, que no formaba parte del plan internacional de evacuación, ha sido alcanzado por un proyectil en aguas de Omán

events.headline: OIL PRICE FALLS BACK TO PRE-IRAN WAR LEVELS
events.detail: Signs that traffic through the key Strait of Hormuz shipping route is gradually resuming has helped to push the oil price down.

events.headline: US AND IRAN CLASH OVER HORMUZ TRANSIT TOLL

events.headline: IRAN TO SET UP HORMUZ HOTLINE WITH US
